_columns.name: str; shown to the player
_columns.sublevels: etbs; streamed levels drawn with it
_columns.start_tag: str; Tag of the PlayerStart actors a run begins at
_columns.exit_class: str; class of the actor that ends the run when reached
_columns.exit_tag: str; Tag of the PlayerStarts next to the exit, used by the autotest
_columns.floor_y: int; Minecraft y of Unreal z=0
_columns.kill_z_cm: float; Unreal z below which the player has fallen out of the map
_columns.entity: ref:entities; what hunts the player here
_columns.entity_class: str; class of the map actor that marks where it starts
